subject: Roper
picture: An original cave ambusher stands like a thick stalagmite: rocky conical body growing from the floor, one wide simple toothy mouth on the upper body, one central eye, four large simple tendrils reaching out. Do not imitate or trace any published creature illustration. Not an octopus and not a tree. Cave ceiling with a few stalactites, rock walls, large floor stones, closed tunnel. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
